patch_description: Keeps the proven pipeline (multi-seed greedy construction + move/swap local search + iterated local search) but replaces the uniform random ILS perturbation with a structured "worst-fit destroying" kick: pick one of the two hottest GPUs and relocate its model with the highest req_rate/slo (the model most responsible for KVPR pressure) to a feasible destination, plus one random relocation. This targeted kick escapes the exact local optima that block refine(), whereas random moves frequently wander back to the same basin. Also slightly increase ILS iterations since execution time remains negligible.
